title: Research
text:
My research centers on differential geometry and its connections with topology, rigidity, and dynamics.


I study relationships between curvature, global geometry, and the topology and dynamics of manifolds. Recurring themes include nonpositively curved manifolds, locally symmetric spaces, rigidity phenomena, and geodesic flows.



Another focus is the interaction of geometric structures with topological invariants, including simplicial volume and homological questions for manifolds and discrete groups.



I am interested in geometric aspects of ergodic theory, random walks, and dynamics on curved spaces.



A selection of research articles and preprints is available on the publications page. That list is being expanded and connected to journal and arXiv metadata.
